name: release
summary: Publish the plugin installers (BlokDust-<version>-Mac.pkg and -Windows.exe from `bd plugin package` / `bd win package`) to downloads.funputs.com/releases/blokdust/<version>/ and write web/src/releases.json, which the web app's Settings › DOWNLOAD tab reads. Immutable: refuses a version already published. `tag` tags vX.Y.Z on main and publishes its GitHub release (docs/engineering/branches-and-releases.md); it deploys nothing.
outputs: JSON summary on stdout; web/src/releases.json; objects in the funputs-releases R2 bucket
